instruction: Create a Python function that checks whether a number is even
output:
```python
def is_even(number):
    return number % 2 == 0
```

The remainder operator `%` returns the remainder after division. An even number has a remainder of zero when divided by 2.

```python
from django.db import models

class Book(models.Model):
    title = models.CharField(max_length=200)
    author = models.CharField(max_length=200)
    published_year = models.PositiveIntegerField(null=True, blank=True)

    def __str__(self):
        return self.title
```

This model stores the book title, author and optional publication year.
